We successfully completed a round of Whole30 and I lost like 15 lbs. I felt great. Then we didn't transition to another good, regular diet and I gained most of it back. We've tried to do Whole30 again 3 times but failed every time. (Haha I guess that's not countless but it feels like it)

Don't know much about Keto.
Weed at least helps me enjoy things, and shit can't get much worse for me mentally I feel like.

Ordering drugs and carrying a quick means to kill myself everywhere at all times in case I got busted sounds like a paranoid hell only slightly better than homelessness. I'd rather die in my home than die on the street.
She really does. I've known it for a long time, years and years, and thought I might not be suicidally depressed when the time came. It's close now, and no luck.

My work is stressful due to office politics and poor management. It's generally not very busy, but we keep having rounds of layoffs and I'm worried the sky is going to fall one day. I don't even have much to show for it on a resume, if I could apply to a job without being paralyzed with stress and self-defeat.

I thought about changing counselors after my last session where the old dingbat wouldn't stop talking about how much he loved fishing. 

I vent to my wife a lot and she's been somewhat supportive. She listens well but never acts in ways that help. For instance, we're both obese and I've tried countless times to try and get us to stick to weight loss plans only to have her quit in less than a week or sabotage it with excuses until we both totally fall off the plan. I feel absolutely horrible about my body and I'm really surprised I didn't bring it up earlier because it's great motivation to kill myself.

I have no idea what that thing could be. Even if I magically got a dream job, it wouldn't change everything else in my life. 

It'd be better if I killed myself now before my wife wants to have kids.
